title: Spectral canary allocator with degradation shepherd and staged holdpoints
author: Jordan Meyer
description:
Motivation: we need a more robust canary allocator for multi-variant A/B and shadow workflows that can detect and shepherd degraded cohorts while preserving session affinity. Current allocators either (a) promote too aggressively when transient noise is present or (b) hold traffic too long, causing unnecessary exposure. This PR introduces a 'spectral canary allocator' that reasons about cohort health across multiple signal bands (latency, error spike spectral density, quality drift) and a degradation shepherd that inserts staged holdpoints and credit windows to automatically quarantine or slow promotions.

What this changes: single continuous set of changes across allocator, scheduler and telemetry adapters: - allocator/spectral.go: new allocator that computes a spectral health vector and assigns promote/slow/quarantine decisions per cohort - rollout/holdpoints.go: staged holdpoint primitives with credit accounting and time-decayed forgiveness - scheduler/adhoc_flow.go: improved draining logic to respect holdpoints and session leases - telemetry/signal_transform.go: band-pass features and PSD (power spectral density) summary helpers - e2e/rollout_spectral_test.go: deterministic simulation harness with synthetic spectral anomalies - docs/rollouts/spectral-canary.md: design doc and operator guide (short)

Checklist: - [x] Design doc drafted and linked - [x] Unit tests for allocator logic - [x] Integration tests for staged holdpoints - [x] Telemetry metrics added for SLO/credit usage - [x] Backwards-compatible: existing RolloutPolicy remains valid; feature gated behind config flag

Compatibility and rollout plan: this is feature-flagged (rollout.feature.spectral_canary=false by default). We will enable in a beta Dedicated cluster and run synthetic stress for 72 hours before flipping default for internal canaries. Observability: added metrics rollouts.spectral.promote_decision, rollouts.spectral.quarantine_rate, rollouts.spectral.credit_balance. All metrics are tagged by cohort_id/model_version and environment.

Notes: The description consolidates the rationale and lists high-level files changed and tests. See commits for incremental steps.
